1	# Registrar rules
2	
3	These are the rules as the registrar would say them. `/gnd:gnd-model-from-text`
4	turns this file into `model.orm.json`.
5	
6	- A student can't take a course before passing every course it needs,
7	  directly or through a chain of prerequisites.
8	- A student doesn't enroll in a course they have already passed.
9	- A student takes at most 6 courses in a term.
10	- A student takes at most 18 credits in a term.
11	- A student has one grade per course, and once a grade is recorded it never
12	  changes.
13	- Only courses offered that term can be taken.
14	
15	## What the registrar does
16	
17	- Enroll a student in a course for a term.
18	- Drop a course, or every course in a term.
19	- Record a grade, which also marks the course as passed.
20	- Admit a new student.
21	
22	## The spring catalogue
23	
24	| Course | Credits | Needs | Offered |
25	|---|---|---|---|
26	| CS101 Intro to Programming | 4 | | spring |
27	| MATH120 Calculus | 4 | | |

29	| STAT210 Probability | 3 | MATH120 | spring |

usage: gnd [-h] [--version]
           {witness,replay,witness-view,import,validate,diff,coverage,check,verbalize,verify,synth,measure,extract,export,codegen,conformance,recovery,evolve,doccheck,fidelity,review,exp,solve,install,doctor,uninstall,judgments}
           ...

GND ORM runtime: validate conceptual models, check populations

positional arguments:
  {witness,replay,witness-view,import,validate,diff,coverage,check,verbalize,verify,synth,measure,extract,export,codegen,conformance,recovery,evolve,doccheck,fidelity,review,exp,solve,install,doctor,uninstall,judgments}
    witness             produce a finite grounded derivation witness
    replay              independently replay a finite derivation witness
    witness-view        view a witness with default value redaction
    import              import a supported foreign ORM dialect create-once
    validate            validate a model and bind declared fixed reference
                        populations
    diff                compare two models over one vocabulary
    coverage            report claims and cited evidence for every addressable
                        model element
    check               check a population against a model, or a walk between
                        two populations
    verbalize           render supplied facts as deterministic sentences
    verify              run the full derived verifier over a pre-extracted
                        population (VER-01, VER-02)
    synth               generate labelled synthetic populations from a model
                        (DATA-01)
    measure             measure per-constraint false-pass/false-fail/undecided
                        rates (VER-03)
    extract             emit the per-model extraction artifact bundle (VER-01,
                        DATA-02)
    export              export an optional standalone artifact
    codegen             emit a plain-Python agent project derived from the
                        model (GEN-01)
    conformance         check that a generated project still matches its model
                        (GEN-02); temporal models refused
    recovery            inventory static code evidence and verify one
                        recovered model bundle
    evolve              preview, apply, and finalize one digest-bound model
                        evolution
    doccheck            validate a rendered document's manifest against its
                        renderer obligations (DATA-02)
    fidelity            measure extractor fidelity per fact type over
                        committed cases (DATA-02)
    review              run the bounded six-reviewer advisory panel and
                        finalize its synthesis (REV-01)
    exp                 scaffold, author, run, validate, and close experiments
    solve               walk the CLI-pure GND stations in order, gating each,
                        and log the walk
    install             place every packaged GND skill into your agent
                        runtime's skills directory
    doctor              report the state of every GND skill this machine has
                        placed
    uninstall           remove the GND skills this machine placed, leaving
                        your own edits alone
    judgments           evaluate saved external opinions

object_types:

        status: proposed
        modality: deontic

        provenance:
          llm_prompt_id: reference-scheme-injective
          rationale_world_fact: "A popular reference mode requires an injective identifying binary; otherwise the entity is not identified."
          csdp_step: 1
          dialogue_turn: 1

  - id: course_has_code
    reading: "{Course} has code {CourseCode}"
    roles:
      - { object_type: course, role_name: course }

      - { course: "MATH220", course_code: "MATH220" }
      - { course: "STAT210", course_code: "STAT210" }
      - { course: "CS230", course_code: "CS230" }
      - { course: "CS250", course_code: "CS250" }
      - { course: "CS340", course_code: "CS340" }
      - { course: "PHIL101", course_code: "PHIL101" }
    constraints:
      - type: uniqueness
        roles: [course]
        source: sample
        status: proposed
        modality: deontic
        rationale: "Reference scheme: each Course has one code. Observed in the catalogue table (8 courses, one code each)."
        provenance:
          sample_size: 8
          observed_values: ["CS101", "MATH120", "MATH220", "STAT210", "CS230", "CS250", "CS340", "PHIL101"]
      - type: uniqueness
        roles: [course_code]
        source: sample
        status: proposed
        modality: deontic
        rationale: "Reference scheme: a code names one Course. Observed in the catalogue table."
        provenance:
          sample_size: 8
          observed_values: ["CS101", "MATH120", "MATH220", "STAT210", "CS230", "CS250", "CS340", "PHIL101"]

  - id: term_has_label
    reading: "{Term} has label {TermLabel}"
    roles:
      - { object_type: term, role_name: term }
      - { object_type: term_label, role_name: term_label }
    constraints:
      - type: uniqueness
        roles: [term]
        source: llm-inferred
        status: proposed
        modality: deontic
        rationale: "Reference scheme for Term. The rules mention terms only generically; the label format is an open question."
        provenance:

        source: llm-inferred
        status: proposed
        modality: deontic
        rationale: "A term label names one Term."
        provenance:
          llm_prompt_id: reference-scheme-injective
          rationale_world_fact: "A popular reference mode requires an injective identifying binary; otherwise the entity is not identified."
          csdp_step: 1
          dialogue_turn: 1

  # --- catalogue ---------------------------------------------------------
  - id: course_has_credits
    reading: "{Course} is worth {Credits} credits"
    roles:
      - { object_type: course, role_name: course }
      - { object_type: credits, role_name: credits }

      - { course: "CS101", credits: 4 }
      - { course: "MATH120", credits: 4 }
      - { course: "MATH220", credits: 4 }
      - { course: "STAT210", credits: 3 }
      - { course: "CS230", credits: 4 }
      - { course: "CS250", credits: 3 }
      - { course: "CS340", credits: 4 }
      - { course: "PHIL101", credits: 3 }
    constraints:
      - type: uniqueness
        roles: [course]
        source: sample
        status: proposed
        modality: deontic
        rationale: "Each Course has one credit value. Observed in the catalogue table."
        provenance:
          sample_size: 8
          observed_values: [3, 4]

  - id: course_needs_course
    reading: "{Course:course} needs {Course:prerequisite}"
    roles:
      - { object_type: course, role_name: course }
      - { object_type: course, role_name: prerequisite }
    sample_population:
      - { course: "CS230", prerequisite: "CS101" }
      - { course: "MATH220", prerequisite: "MATH120" }
      - { course: "STAT210", prerequisite: "MATH120" }
      - { course: "CS250", prerequisite: "CS101" }
      - { course: "CS340", prerequisite: "CS230" }
      - { course: "CS340", prerequisite: "MATH220" }
      - { course: "CS340", prerequisite: "STAT210" }

  - id: course_offered_in_season
    reading: "{Course} is offered in {Season}"
    roles:
      - { object_type: course, role_name: course }
      - { object_type: season, role_name: season }
    sample_population:
      - { course: "CS101", season: "spring" }
      - { course: "MATH220", season: "spring" }
      - { course: "STAT210", season: "spring" }
      - { course: "CS230", season: "spring" }
      - { course: "CS250", season: "fall" }
      - { course: "CS340", season: "spring" }
      - { course: "PHIL101", season: "spring" }

  - id: term_has_season
    reading: "{Term} is a {Season} term"
    roles:
      - { object_type: term, role_name: term }
      - { object_type: season, role_name: season }
    constraints:
      - type: mandatory
        role: term
        source: llm-inferred
        status: proposed
        modality: deontic
        rationale: "Offerings are checked by season, so every Term needs a season. Without one the offering guard cannot bind and would pass silently."
        provenance:
          llm_prompt_id: term-needs-season
          rationale_world_fact: "A term with no season cannot be matched against a course's offered seasons."
          csdp_step: 5
          dialogue_turn: 1

  # --- registrar facts ---------------------------------------------------
  - id: student_enrolled_in_course_in_term
    reading: "{Student} enrolled in {Course} in {Term}"
    roles:
      - { object_type: student, role_name: student }
      - { object_type: course, role_name: course }
      - { object_type: term, role_name: term }
    constraints:
      - type: frequency
        scope: internal
        roles: [student, term]
        bound: { max: 6 }
        source: explicit
        status: confirmed
        modality: alethic
        provenance:
          csdp_step: 4
          dialogue_turn: 1
          user_quote: "A student takes at most 6 courses in a term."

  - id: student_passed_course
    reading: "{Student} passed {Course}"
    roles:
      - { object_type: student, role_name: student }
      - { object_type: course, role_name: course }
    sample_population:
      - { student: "Maya", course: "CS101" }
      - { student: "Maya", course: "MATH120" }
      - { student: "Maya", course: "CS230" }

  - id: student_course_grade
    reading: "{Student} got grade {Grade} in {Course}"
    roles:
      - { object_type: student, role_name: student }
      - { object_type: course, role_name: course }
      - { object_type: grade, role_name: grade }
    constraints:
      - type: uniqueness
        roles: [student, course]
        source: explicit
        status: confirmed
        modality: alethic
        provenance:
          csdp_step: 4
          dialogue_turn: 1
          user_quote: "A student has one grade per course, and once a grade is recorded it never changes."

  # --- derived fact types (structured, ORM++) -----------------------------
  - id: course_transitively_needs_course
    reading: "{Course:course} transitively needs {Course:prerequisite}"
    roles:
      - { object_type: course, role_name: course }
      - { object_type: course, role_name: prerequisite }
    derivation: derived
    storage: computed
    derivation_rule:
      clauses:
        - body:
            - { fact_type: course_needs_course, bind: { course: "$c", prerequisite: "$p" } }
        - body:
            - { fact_type: course_needs_course, bind: { course: "$c", prerequisite: "$m" } }
            - { fact_type: course_transitively_needs_course, bind: { course: "$m", prerequisite: "$p" } }
      head: { course: "$c", prerequisite: "$p" }

  - id: student_credits_in_term
    reading: "{Student} takes {Credits} credits in {Term}"
    roles:
      - { object_type: student, role_name: student }
      - { object_type: term, role_name: term }
      - { object_type: credits, role_name: credits }
    derivation: derived
    storage: computed
    derivation_rule:
      body:
        - { fact_type: student_enrolled_in_course_in_term, bind: { student: "$s", course: "$c", term: "$t" } }
        - { fact_type: course_has_credits, bind: { course: "$c", credits: "$k" } }
      aggregate: { fn: sum, of: "$k", over: ["$c"], as: "$total" }
      head: { student: "$s", term: "$t", credits: "$total" }

constraints:
  # Enrolment may only be in a course offered in that term's season.
  - id: enrolment_only_offered_course
    type: guarded
    antecedent:
      - { fact_type: student_enrolled_in_course_in_term, bind: { student: "$s", course: "$c", term: "$t" } }
      - { fact_type: term_has_season, bind: { term: "$t", season: "$z" } }
    consequent:
      atom: { fact_type: course_offered_in_season, bind: { course: "$c", season: "$z" } }
    source: explicit
    status: confirmed
    modality: alethic
    rationale: "Only courses offered that term can be taken."
    provenance:
      csdp_step: 3
      dialogue_turn: 1
      user_quote: "Only courses offered that term can be taken."

  # Enrolment requires every prerequisite, direct or through a chain, to be passed.
  - id: enrolment_requires_passed_prerequisites
    type: guarded
    antecedent:
      - { fact_type: student_enrolled_in_course_in_term, bind: { student: "$s", course: "$c", term: "$t" } }
      - { fact_type: course_transitively_needs_course, bind: { course: "$c", prerequisite: "$p" } }
    consequent:
      atom: { fact_type: student_passed_course, bind: { student: "$s", course: "$p" } }
    source: explicit
    status: confirmed
    modality: alethic
    rationale: "A student can't take a course before passing every course it needs, directly or through a chain. Chain is handled by the derived transitive fact type."
    provenance:
      csdp_step: 3
      dialogue_turn: 1
      user_quote: "A student can't take a course before passing every course it needs, directly or through a chain of prerequisites."

  # Enrolment is refused for a course already passed.
  - id: no_enrolment_in_passed_course
    type: guarded
    antecedent:
      - { fact_type: student_enrolled_in_course_in_term, bind: { student: "$s", course: "$c", term: "$t" } }
    consequent:
      absence: { fact_type: student_passed_course, bind: { student: "$s", course: "$c" } }
    source: explicit
    status: confirmed
    modality: alethic
    rationale: "A student doesn't enroll in a course they have already passed."
    provenance:
      csdp_step: 3
      dialogue_turn: 1
      user_quote: "A student doesn't enroll in a course they have already passed."

  # Recording a grade marks the course as passed.
  - id: grade_marks_course_passed
    type: guarded
    antecedent:
      - { fact_type: student_course_grade, bind: { student: "$s", course: "$c", grade: "$g" } }
    consequent:
      atom: { fact_type: student_passed_course, bind: { student: "$s", course: "$c" } }
    source: explicit
    status: confirmed
    modality: alethic
    rationale: "Record a grade, which also marks the course as passed."
    provenance:
      csdp_step: 3
      dialogue_turn: 1
      user_quote: "Record a grade, which also marks the course as passed."

  # At most 18 credits in a term.
  - id: term_credit_cap
    type: guarded
    antecedent:
      - { fact_type: student_credits_in_term, bind: { student: "$s", term: "$t", credits: "$k" } }
    consequent:
      comparison: { operator: "<=", left: "$k", right: 18 }
    source: explicit
    status: confirmed
    modality: alethic
    rationale: "A student takes at most 18 credits in a term."
    provenance:
      csdp_step: 3
      dialogue_turn: 1
      user_quote: "A student takes at most 18 credits in a term."

  # Season domain (catalogue table values).
  - type: value
    object_type: season
    allowed: ['spring', 'fall']
    source: sample
    status: proposed
    modality: deontic
    rationale: "Only spring and fall appear in the catalogue table. Whether these are the only seasons is open."
    provenance:
      sample_size: 8
      observed_values: ["spring", "fall"]

  # Grade-immutability is a transition rule; a single population cannot show it.
  - type: textual
    expression: "Once a grade is recorded for a student in a course, it never changes."
    formal_language: natural
    formal_expression: null
    source: explicit
    status: confirmed
    modality: deontic
    rationale: "Transition rule, not checkable on one population. Kept deontic to avoid permanent exit 4 (D-20). Override of the explicit-source alethic default is recorded here; owner may upgrade if it moves into operations."
    provenance:
      csdp_step: 7
      dialogue_turn: 1
      user_quote: "once a grade is recorded it never changes."

MODEL VERBALIZATION — registrar enrolment (one-shot draft from rules.md)
Status: DRAFT for stakeholder review. Items marked [proposed] are not yet confirmed.

OBJECT TYPES
- Student is identified by StudentId.
- Course is identified by CourseCode.
- Term is identified by TermLabel.
- Season, Credits (integer), Grade are value types.

FACT TYPES
F1  Student has StudentId.                        [proposed reference scheme, one-to-one]
F2  Course has CourseCode.                        [catalogue table; one-to-one proposed]
F3  Course is worth Credits credits.              [catalogue table]
F4  Course needs Course (prerequisite).           [catalogue table: Needs column]
F5  Course is offered in Season.                  [catalogue table: Offered column]
F6  Term has TermLabel.                           [proposed reference scheme]
F7  Term is a Season term.                        [proposed]
F8  Student enrolled in Course in Term.           [registrar rule]
F9  Student passed Course.                        [sample: Maya passed CS101, MATH120, CS230]
F10 Student in Course got Grade.                  [registrar rule]
F11 Course transitively needs Course.             [derived: F4, closed over chains]
F12 Student in Term takes Credits credits.        [derived: sum of credits of enrolled courses]

CONSTRAINTS
C1  Each Student enrolled in a Course in a Term: the Course is offered in the Season of that Term.
    Only courses offered that term can be taken.                                  [registrar rule, alethic]
C2  Each Student enrolled in a Course: for every Course that it transitively needs, the Student passed it.
    A student can't take a course before passing every course it needs, directly or through a chain. [registrar rule, alethic]
C3  Each Student enrolled in a Course: the Student has not passed that Course.
    A student doesn't enroll in a course they have already passed.                 [registrar rule, alethic]
C4  Each Student who got a Grade in a Course: the Student passed that Course.
    Record a grade, which also marks the course as passed.                         [registrar rule, alethic]
C5  Each Student has at most one Grade per Course; a Grade never changes once recorded.
    A student has one grade per course.                                           [registrar rule, alethic]
C6  Each Student in a Term takes at most 6 Courses in that Term.                  [registrar rule, alethic]
C7  Each Student in a Term takes at most 18 Credits in that Term.                 [registrar rule, alethic, derived via F12]
C8  Once a grade is recorded it never changes.                                    [textual, deontic: transition rule, not checkable on one population]
C9  Season is spring or fall.                                                     [proposed, deontic]
C10 Each Term has exactly one Season.                                             [proposed mandatory, deontic]
C11 Each StudentId, CourseCode and TermLabel identifies at most one entity.       [proposed, deontic]
C12 Each Course is worth one Credits value.                                       [proposed, deontic]

QUESTIONS FOR THE REGISTRAR
Q1  MATH120 has no entry under Offered. Is it offered in no term? If so, nobody can take it under C1.
Q2  How is a Student identified? The rules name students (e.g. Maya) but give no identifier.
Q3  What form does a Term take (for example "2027 spring")? Is a term always one season?
Q4  What grades can be recorded? A grade of failing would conflict with "a grade marks the course passed".
Q5  Is "passed" a separate fact from a recorded grade, or always implied by one?
Q6  Is there a rule that prerequisite courses must be acyclic (no course needs itself through a chain)?
Q7  The registrar's actions (admit, enroll, drop, drop term, record grade) are not modelled yet. For each: should an undeclared side effect be a hard failure or a warning?
